text: What a finish! Kian Romano scored for Seabrook Town from just 3.2 meters out, after a quick, sharp move involving Tomas Kowalski’s clever assist. This goal put Seabrook ahead 4-2 in the final moments, capping a slick team effort that started with a long pass and then two perfect passes on the wing. Seabrook’s wide attacking style really showed here, while Harbour City struggled to keep up in the last 10 minutes. [#1904] [#1906] [#1901]
